chunks: And as for what Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Safwan from Jamil from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in
a woman who married before her waiting period ended, he said: They are separated, and she observes one waiting period for both.

key_terms.عِدَّةٌ: Waiting period (iddah) after divorce or death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman marries before her iddah ends?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Isfarayini, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that if a woman contracts a second marriage before her iddah from the first concludes, the second union is valid but requires separation once the first iddah ends. Notably, she observes only one combined waiting period for both marriages, a ruling that highlights the juristic distinction between the validity of the contract and the completion of the waiting period. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the continuity of the iddah period even when overlapping with a new marital bond.
